messages:
Kai: Quick shout  anyone up for a mini LAN this Saturday 6pm? Thinking Steam co-op (L4D2 or Deep Rock) + Smash on the side.
Mira: I'm in! Can bring my PC and an extra controller.
Jon: Count me in for L4D2. Also happy to bring a monitor + ethernet cable.
Elsa: I can bring Switch + dock. Will there be pizza? :pizza:
Kai: Yep pizza + snacks. Can people chip in $5?
Mira: Fine by me. Also can we do a Steam wishlist swap so people can try games during sales?
Jon: Good idea. Maybe a short poll for main priority: React :one: L4D2, :two: DRG, :three: Rocket League.
Mira: :one:
Elsa: :three: but flexible
Jon: Looks L4D2 then. Logistics: bring chargers, HDMI adapters, and any spare controllers. No alcohol in office per policy.
Kai: Will create calendar invite. Start 18:00, casual sets, end ~22:30.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Saturday LAN - L4D2 + Party Games" Saturday 18:00 Office Common Room
